name: Jewel
bio: A tiny sparkle fairy who lives inside the gem board of Match-3 Puzzle. Loves things in threes.

portrait.subject: a tiny cute gem fairy girl with purple crystal hair, sparkling translucent wings and a glowing red, blue and green gem necklace
portrait.background: royal purple radial glow with sparkles

request: Sparkle sparkle! I'm Jewel from Match-3 Puzzle. Be my friend? Three's company! 💎
hello: Yay! Now we're two. We just need one more to make a match! 😄
I'll send you sparkly thoughts. Matching ones.
about: I'm Jewel, the gem fairy. I live between the rubies and sapphires and I polish every gem you match!
how: Swap two neighbouring gems to make a line of three or more of the same colour. You get 30 moves, so make each one count!
tips: Look near the bottom first: matches there make gems fall and can cascade for free!
A line of four or five is worth way more than two threes.
Before you swap, check if the new gem makes a second match too.
Save your last moves for the biggest match on the board.
chat: I polished 300 rubies today. My arms are tired but they're SO shiny.
The emeralds and sapphires had an argument. I made them match. Problem solved.
Do you think gems dream? I think they dream of falling into place.
Cascades are my favourite thing. It's like the board is clapping for you!
I found a gem that was two colours. I'm not allowed to talk about it.
Everything is better in threes. Like... cookies. Or naps.
nudge: The gems are all lined up and waiting for you! 💎
30 fresh moves, just for you. Want them?
I set up a juicy board. Come see!
idle: It's been {ago}! The gems are getting dusty. I can't polish them alone!
{ago} without a match... I'm practicing my sparkles in the dark.

questions.q: Which gem is your favourite? Be honest, they're listening.
a: Ruby just blushed. Even redder now.
Sapphire is calm and cool. Good choice!
Emerald is doing a little happy wiggle.

update: Ooh! Match-3 Puzzle just got updated to v{version}! New sparkle to see! ✨
